description: Use this when a webhook URL, event list, inbox filter, or enabled flag should change. Requires auth. Inputs: webhook_id (required), url (optional http(s) URL), events (optional array), enabled (optional boolean; true re-enables and resets consecutive_failures, false disables and stops deliveries), inbox_ids (optional; at most 10 inbox ids). Returns the webhook with the secret redacted. A disabled hook receives no deliveries. Fails with 404 webhook_not_found, 400 too_many_inboxes, 400 invalid_url, or 404 inbox_not_found.

enabled.description: true re-enables the hook and resets consecutive_failures to 0. false disables it.

events.description: Replacement event list. At least one of message.received, message.held, message.sent, message.blocked, message.bounced, message.complained, task.received, owner.reply, domain.verified, draft.created, draft.approved, draft.rejected, draft.sent, account.sending_paused, account.sending_resumed, thread.assigned, thread.unassigned, thread.folder_updated, question.answered, or question.expired.

inbox_ids.description: Replacement inbox filter, at most 10 ids. An empty array matches every inbox. More than 10 returns 400 too_many_inboxes.

name: cooper_update_webhook

outputSchema.description: The webhook after the update, secret redacted.

client_id.description: Caller idempotency key stored with the object, or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

disabled_at.description: ISO-8601 time Cooper disabled the hook, or null.

disabled_reason.description: Why the hook was disabled, or null.

enabled.description: True when the object is active.

headers.description: Extra delivery headers. Values are redacted.

id.description: Stable id of the returned object. Pass it to the matching get, update, or delete tool.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

inbox_ids.description: Inbox ids this object is limited to. Empty means every inbox on the account.

previous_secret_active.description: True while deliveries are also signed with the previous secret.

previous_secret_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time the previous secret stops signing, or null.

secret.description: Signing secret. Shown in full once on create or rotate, redacted otherwise.

title: Update webhook
